fullName.value: G-patch domain and KOW motifs-containing protein

texts.value: RNA-binding protein involved in pre-mRNA splicing. As a component of the minor spliceosome, involved in the splicing of U12-type introns in pre-mRNAs (Probable)

Component of the minor spliceosome, which splices U12-type introns (PubMed:33509932). Interacts with PRKX (PubMed:16491121). Interacts with DHX16 (PubMed:25296192). Interacts with PRKACB (PubMed:21880142)
Phosphorylation regulates its ability to bind RNA
